svg.title: Solory bank reconciliation: invoice sent, payment received, matched automatically
svg.desc: Card with demo data in three labelled steps. It builds once on load and then stays on its final state. Step 01, invoice sent: invoice QR-2026-014 for Bergmann Architektur GmbH, total CHF 3'675.40, with a Swiss QR-bill and the status Open. Step 02, payment received: a credit of plus 3'675.40 from Bergmann Architektur GmbH, booked at UBS CH and imported from a camt.053 bank statement. Step 03, matched: a line links the credit to the invoice total through a check mark, and the invoice status changes from Open to Paid.
